stories.title: CDF Munir vows to ‘hit hard’ Indian-sponsored terrorist outfits 'wherever they are'
stories.brief: Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir vowed to continue the campaign against “Indian-sponsored terrorist outfits” and “hit them hard wherever they are”, the military's media wing said on Friday. According to a statement issued by the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), CDF Munir visited Corps Headquarters in Peshawar.

stories.title: Organ trade network busted
stories.brief: The Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) has busted an organised gang involved in illegal kidney transplants in the federal capital, arresting five suspects, recovering Rs1 million in cash, freezing properties worth Rs87.5 million and seizing three vehicles.

stories.title: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
stories.brief: The Meta boss had said he would exit the state over a wealth tax that has not yet come into force.

stories.title: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?
stories.brief: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

stories.title: Peshawar High Court bars arrest of KP Assembly deputy speaker
stories.brief: PESHAWAR: The Peshawar High Court (PHC) has restrained the authorities from arresting Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Assembly Deputy Speaker Suriya Bibi until Nov 10, while allowing her to retain access to her official residence.

stories.title: FM Dar arrives to attend first R4+E3 foreign ministers’ meeting in Istanbul
stories.brief: Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 arrived in Istanbul, Türkiye, to participate in the R4 as well as the R4+ France, Germany, Italy, and UK Ministerial Meeting.

stories.title: PHC bars arrest of inactive K-P deputy speaker, suspends eviction notice
stories.brief: Advocate Yasir Khattak appeared on behalf of the petitioner, the inactive Deputy Speaker. Opposing the petition, the Advocate General submitted that an emergency empowers the provincial government to reclaim official residences allotted to ministers, advisers and the Deputy Speaker.

stories.title: The Indian workers filming their work to train AI
stories.brief: Indian workers are being paid to film themselves at work and the footage is used to train AI.

stories.title: Lights will stay on this winter, grid operator says after concerns
stories.brief: The assurance from the National Energy System Operator comes amid concern from its engineers about their ability to ensure adequate supply.

stories.title: Renting in London - 'I pay £2,000 for one bedroom'
stories.brief: We ask people in the capital how much they pay for their homes.

stories.title: Blue Planet III: Moment octopus escapes death after hunt gone wrong
stories.brief: The sequence is part of the latest Blue Planet series from Sir David Attenborough.

stories.title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skincare sales
stories.brief: The beauty giant's CEO says the use of GLP-1s is "a very important phenomenon for us".

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton aims to extend career till early 2030s so he can race in African Grand Prix
stories.brief: 41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights recordLewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s.

stories.title: Gasps as Prince William makes surprise appearance on Graham Norton Show
stories.brief: The Prince of Wales was marking his Earthshot Prize, to which all of Norton's guests were linked.

stories.title: Firefighters and public 'knowingly put at risk' during summer wildfires
stories.brief: Crews and control centre staff say the fires were relentless with many firefighters still off work injured.

stories.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
stories.brief: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

stories.title: Damaging hail pelts Phoenix in rare storm
stories.brief: Videos from the Arizona capital show people sheltering inside a car as hail smashes the windscreen, while intense downpours covered neighbourhoods in ice.

stories.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
stories.brief: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.
